#include <vector>

long long mod_pow(long long base, int exp, int mod) {
    long long result = 1;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) result = (result * base) % mod;
        base = (base * base) % mod;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

int main() {
    int p, k;
    cin >> p >> k;
    if (k == 0) {
        cout << mod_pow(p, p - 1, 1000000007) << endl;
        return 0;
    }
    if (k == 1) {
        cout << mod_pow(p, p, 1000000007) << endl;
        return 0;
    }
    vector<bool> visited(p + 1, false);
    int len = 1;
    long long i = k;
    visited[1] = true;
    while (!visited[i]) {
        visited[i] = true;
        i = (i * k) % p;
        len++;
    }
    long long tot = (p - 1) / len;
    cout << mod_pow(p, tot, 1000000007) << endl;
    return 0;
}
